title: Closing Fee Settlement on Contingency Placement Agreements Under Termination Notice
content:
A creditor client that has given termination notice on an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements may settle the fees it owes on that agreement with one closing settlement payment, which the client makes itself. Where a termination notice is on record, a payment of the fees owed on that agreement is a closing settlement payment even when the client names one of its invoices.

## When the figure is worked out

The closing settlement payment is worked out only after the agreement's fees owed carry the early-termination charge due for the termination notice on record.

Put the other way: while the agreement's fees owed do not yet carry the early-termination charge due for the termination notice on record, there is no closing settlement figure for that agreement.

## Payment instrument: `pay_closing_fee_settlement_180c3708`

**Capability.** The creditor client pays its closing fee settlement on a contingency placement agreement for which it has given termination notice. One call records one fee payment from the client against that agreement, dated today, and lowers the fees the client owes Ridgeline on the agreement by the amount paid. The client receives a payment confirmation reference it can quote to its accounts-payable team.

**How it is invoked.** This is the client's own instrument: the representative unlocks `pay_closing_fee_settlement_180c3708` and hands it over, and the client — the customer themselves — runs it to make the payment.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the placement agreement reference number (agreement id) of the agreement being settled, which the representative reads from the placement agreement lookup and gives to the client | identifier, as the lookup shows it |
| `payment_amount` | the amount the client pays, as the representative states it | USD, always positive, rounded to the nearest cent (2 decimal places) |

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with:

- `entry_id` — the reference of the new client money entry;
- `agreement_id` — the agreement paid on;
- `entry_type` — always `client_fee_payment_received`;
- `amount` — the amount paid, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `payment_ref` — the payment confirmation reference issued for this payment;
- `entry_date` — today, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `fees_owed_after` — the agreement's fees owed after the payment, USD to 2 decimal places.

Receiving the receipt means the payment is recorded.

## Reference questions

**The client asks to pay one named invoice on an agreement with a termination notice on record. Is that a closing settlement payment?** Yes. Where a termination notice is on record, a payment of the fees owed on that agreement is a closing settlement payment even when the client names one of its invoices.

**How many closing settlement payments are there per agreement?** The fees owed on the agreement are settled with one closing settlement payment.

**Who makes the payment?** The client makes it itself, with the instrument handed over to it.
